item.title: ZOZO Marine Stadium Guide: Baseball, Bayfront & Access
item.description: Right on Tokyo Bay in the Makuhari Bayfront, ZOZO Marine Stadium is the seaside home of the Chiba Lotte Marines — and one of the most fun, accessible places for visitors to experience a Japanese pro baseball game. Japanese baseball is a spectacle as much as a sport: nonstop organised chanting, team songs, balloon launches and passionate fan sections create an electric, family-friendly atmosphere quite unlike the game in the West.
